description: Pause a trail's rollout. Pause the release controller on a trail: it stops stepping the flag and watching the guards until the rollout is resumed. The flag stays wherever it is. A trail that ships behind several flags has a rollout per flag; pass `resource` (the flag's trail-resource id or its key) to…

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

reason.description: Why — shown on the release timeline.

resource.description: The flag to pause — its trail-resource id (`TrailResource.id`) or its key. Omitted, every flag on the trail is paused.

name: trails_pause_rollout
